pitch: A one-line status bar for pi: repo state, model, context, cost, cache and timing. This is real pi with the extension, running in your browser on a scripted model.
welcome: [1mpi-statusline[0m replaces pi's footer with one line: repo, model, context, cost, cache and timing.
This is real pi with the extension. The model is scripted, so it knows a few prompts and needs no key.
cd project && pi              start pi in a small sample project
what does this project do?   reads two files: watch context and cost grow
add a --json flag            edits a file and runs it: the branch turns main*
Or press the buttons above, in order.
